description: This file contains a PHP class implementation of a stream object that conforms to the PSR-7 StreamInterface. It handles stream operations such as reading, writing, seeking, and metadata management, wrapping a PHP resource stream.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Implements a PSR-7 StreamInterface, managing a PHP resource stream including file operations and metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a PHP resource stream with options for size and metadata.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the stream resource upon object destruction.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the stream as a string, seeking to the start if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads and returns all remaining contents from the stream.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and detaches the resource.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the stream resource from the object, returning it.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.
